prior_finding.status: ADDRESSED for distinguishable pre-commit navigation replacement
prior_finding.evidence: The approved initial loaderId is read from Page.getFrameTree and passed as Page.reload's loaderId precondition (document-network-capture.ts:459-520). The first accepted main-frame Page.frameStartedNavigating must be a same-URL reload or reloadBypassingCache with a fresh loaderId; an external differentDocument start is rejected, whether it precedes the reload start or follows it before commit (:288-318). A repeated start with the same loader and URL is allowed. Page.frameNavigated must commit that accepted loaderId and URL before buffered events are delivered (:321-353, :207-211). The two new nonce-attested same-URL negative cases assert failure and zero delivered events (document-network-capture.test.ts:374-404); the owned reload test repeats the accepted start and retains old/current context isolation (:198-254).
prior_finding.qualification: CDP does not return a command navigation ID for Page.reload. If an independent manual reload with the same URL and reload navigationType wins the first start, loader/type alone cannot establish command causation. This is a stated protocol limit, not a reproduced regression or a claim of native acceptance.
